description: Figure 7 illustrates a comparison of “better”, “XLM-R”, and “same” counts across several language families. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “task count” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  For each language family, there are three bars representing the counts for “better”, “XLM-R”, and “same”, distinguished by yellow, blue, and green colors respectively. In “IE-Baltic”, the “better” bar reaches approximately 10, the “XLM-R” bar reaches approximately 15, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 25.  In “Uralic”, the “better” bar reaches approximately 35, the “XLM-R” bar reaches approximately 30, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 10. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each language family, allowing for a visual comparison of the counts for each category within that family. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
